name: What are the risks associated with pre-construction condo purchases?

mainEntity.name: What are the risks associated with pre-construction condo purchases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Risks in pre-construction purchases can include construction delays, changes to design plans or finishes, and market fluctuations affecting property values by completion. There's also the possibility of a developer's financial issues. Mitigating these risks involves thorough due diligence on the developer's track record and careful review of contract terms. Kelby Contreras assists clients by providing insight into reputable developers active in the Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach County markets, helping you assess project stability and potential risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Risks include construction delays, design changes, market fluctuations, and developer issues. Due diligence on the developer and contract review are crucial.
